description: An IT Technical Support Executive resolves customer queries and technical issues across various channels, such as voice, non-voice (chat, email), or hybrid formats. The role involves troubleshooting hardware/software problems, providing remote support, documenting resolutions, and ensuring a seamless customer experience. Adherence to organizational protocols, strong communication skills, and the use of technology, including Generative AI, are critical for success.
